plan.subject: full_toolset_local_artifacts_mechanical_verifiers
plan.statement: Brainstorm, plan, and implement a full tool-set for local artifacts and mechanical verifiers. Unify: artifact store helpers, ledger index, merkle, bit-exact compare, adversarial, fuzz, SMT, interval, typed IR, causal graph, sandbox, schema validate, unit tags, knowledge facade probes. No live trading. No completeness oracle. Double-pass mandatory on the tool-set itself.
